items.title: Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence for Hom and Ext groups on a union of two opens
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a ringed space which is the union of two open subspaces and objects E and F of the derived category, the lemma produces a long exact Mayer-Vietoris sequence relating the Hom groups of the restrictions to U, V and their intersection and ending in Ext groups (statement lines 8166-8184). The proof takes the distinguished triangle expressing the extension by zero of the intersection in terms of the extensions by zero of U and V and of the object itself, applies the cohomological functor represented by F to obtain a long exact sequence of Hom groups, and then rewrites each term using the adjunction between extension by zero and restriction to an open (proof lines 8186-8196). The claim is H2: one triangle from a preceding lemma plus one adjunction, with the identification of the terms written out as a displayed formula.
